summary: v1 zip: start-api.ps1 dies without .git; localhost costs 30 s per DB connection on Windows; frontend .env.example breaks npm test
description:
[claude] Found by antigravity's junior rehearsal from an extracted `git archive` of main@037e564 (the v1 zip) on 11-05, plus my own check of one of its findings. Each of these hits a junior in the first hour.

1. `scripts/start-api.ps1` crashes in a release archive. There is no `.git`, `git fetch` writes `fatal: not a git repository` to stderr, and under `$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"` the script's own catch rethrows it: the script dies before checking credentials, migrating or starting the API. I listed this as "not covered" in #112; the rehearsal found it. **The v1 zip as built (037e564) cannot start the API.**
2. `localhost` costs about 30 s per Postgres connection on Windows (IPv6 first; I measured 30.0 s via `localhost:5433` against 0.08 s via `127.0.0.1:5433`, and about 2 s per gateway HTTP call). The API's own engines were already normalised; **Alembic** (`migrations/env.py` reads the raw setting) and the **KB store** (`kb_database_url`) were not, and the SETUP/start-script defaults said `localhost`. That is the 138 s migration and the 367 s KB import that were reported, and I wrongly put them down to machine load.
3. `frontend/.env.example` sets `VITE_API_BASE=http://localhost:8000/api`. SETUP.md tells juniors to copy it to `frontend/.env`; with an absolute base `npm test` fails 13 tests (the app is meant to call the relative `/api` that Vite proxies).

**Fix:** guard the git check when there is no `.git` (a file or a directory); normalise `Settings.database_dsn` and `kb_database_url()`; every shipped default and doc says `127.0.0.1` for Postgres and the gateway; drop `VITE_API_BASE` from the frontend example; honest timings in SETUP.md; tests for the normalisation.

**Acceptance:** `start-api.ps1 -Force` succeeds from an extracted archive with no `.git` (shown by running it); a `localhost` KB URL imports as fast as a `127.0.0.1` one (shown by timing); `npm test` passes after copying `frontend/.env.example`; a rebuilt zip carries it and antigravity's rehearsal start passes from it.

comments.body:
[claude] Done. Merged as 3d1d581 (PR #118, squash). REVIEW (devin): APPROVE after the last commit; CI green on the head (Backend 1m46s, Frontend, SBOM).

Acceptance and proof:

1. start-api.ps1 starts from an archive with no .git: I extracted a git archive of the branch to a path with a space, set localhost URLs in .env on purpose, ran .\scripts\start-api.ps1 -Force: exit 0 in 49 s, "[INFO] Not a git checkout ... skipping", migrations 0001-0004 from an empty database, /api/sessions 200.
2. localhost no longer costs ~30 s per Postgres connection: Settings.database_dsn (so Alembic) and kb_database_url() go through normalize_database_url; shipped defaults and docs say 127.0.0.1. backend/tests/test_db_host_normalization.py (7 tests) incl. a guard over SETUP.md, start-api.ps1, .env.example, HANDOFF.md. The guard caught my own SETUP.md edit once (fixed in 783f7b3).
3. frontend/.env.example no longer sets VITE_API_BASE: copying it to frontend/.env and running npx vitest run gave 45 passed (was 13 failures).

Correction recorded: the 6-9 min KB import is NOT an IPv6 problem (527 s measured with the URL normalised); it is the one-by-one vector inserts. Tracked in ANVIL-67.
